title: GET /confessions rate_remaining is not the requester quota
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/confessions.py
Perspective: correctness

Spec 18.10.7: rate_remaining and rate_reset_s let clients display
rate-limit status for POSTs to this board.

_collection_body (lines 385-389) uses self._node_iid if set, else
hard-codes rate_remaining=CONFESSION_HOURLY_MAX (12) and
rate_reset_s=3600. Default constructor has node_iid=None.

Evidence: after a successful POST, GET /confessions still reports
rate_remaining=12 and rate_reset_s=3600. The poster is identified
only on POST via SenML bn, which GET never consults.

If node_iid is set to the host, remote GET sees the host posting
quota, not the client's remaining 12/hour.

Acceptance: rate_info MUST be for the requesting client using the
same identity as the POST rate limiter. If the requester cannot be
identified, omit rate_remaining/rate_reset_s rather than advertising
a full quota.
